answer: To prevent Sybil infiltration, an agent cluster can route gossip through a bonded registry where each node stakes non-refundable tokens before broadcasting. A newly joined entity acts as a low-frequency beacon whose activity is restricted behind a soft velvet queue until verified by established peers. If an attacker spawns hundreds of puppet identities to pollute the data lagoon, every single alias forfeits its 500-token security deposit upon failing peer audits, turning mass registration into an unsustainable capital sink.
